# RoboCasa GR1 Tabletop

[Home](../../../README.md) · [Documentation](../../README.md) · [All experiments](../../experiments/README.md)

The GR1 Tabletop task set uses a humanoid embodiment with arms, hands, and waist. Our evaluation covers 24 tasks with 50 episodes each.

[Official benchmark](https://github.com/robocasa/robocasa-gr1-tabletop-tasks)
